user.title: Create Combined Media Player
user.description:
Give the combined player a name and select its sources.

**Priority:** The order of selection determines priority — first selected = highest priority. You can adjust the order anytime via *Configure*.

error.sources_required: At least one source is required.

init.title: Edit Combined Media Player
init.description: Rename the player and set the source priority. Slot 1 = highest priority. Leave unused slots on "—".

error.sources_required: At least one source must be set.
